page.overview:
Who is Enaka?

Although she was assigned to guard the Four Nations Summit & Technological Symposium, Enaka was well aware that Minister Khuchtei was in charge, and would not deviate from her orders without very good reason. She was not particularly interested in the summit, and mostly wanted it to come to a close with as little trouble as possible.

Enaka accompanied Khuchtei when she burst into Zoryu Hall to inform the other delegates that crates of rare and valuable meteorite ore had been stolen. The theft of the meteorite metal was very close to her worst nightmare, as she expected to be blamed for failing to protect the metal.

Enaka was driven by her desire to maintain order. She was mostly obedient of those she recognized as her superiors, though she could grow worried when she expected to be blamed for any perceived failings.

Enaka was a skilled firebender. Her signature technique was using a "flamecharge" to hurtle at her foe with enormous speed and force.
